desc: 剖面分层耐拉不破，油渣只留在纸上，揭起即弃免刷炸篮
leaf: 三层加厚空气炸锅硅油纸垫
name: 三层加厚空气炸锅硅油纸垫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用立起叠片阵与展开首片讲清预折皱边造型。
一秒给出厚韧耐拉、外扯不开裂的核心利益，承接首图点击后的判断。
shots.textZone: upper left band, one short headline plus one sub-label

shots.intent: 用剖面分离的内层结构与涂层拒液面解释为什么防油不破，承担机制说明。
同机位双联对照，一眼证明油渣只落在纸垫上而篮体依旧干净。
讲清铺纸、加料压重与禁止空烧的用法顺序，消除纸边被吹起烧焦的顾虑。
shots.textZone: one short label under each step card

shots.intent: 用同机位四格覆盖炸烤烘多菜式，让买家代入自家日常餐单并抬升用量合理性。
以空白材质图标列与石板盛料实拍降低入口接触安全方面的顾虑。
收口促单，用空白规格框与底部横条承接尺寸适配的最后一步决策。
shots.textZone: full-width lower bar, one short closing line

style.backgroundSystem: seamless bright white #FFFFFF for the packshot, pale putty-cream #F5F1E9 field for benefit and infographic screens, cool light stone #E8E4DC and #E4E2DE for material and macro screens, one deep green #2E6B4F panel reserved for the closing screen
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the deep green #2E6B4F or the mustard accent #EFA91B only, one icon per claim, no filled or cartoon glyphs and no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: neutral bright studio light, front-left softbox key with a bounce card on the shadow side, gentle directional contact shadows, skimming light only on macro screens, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-contrast kitchen consumable commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale putty-cream field #F5F1E9, deep charcoal wording #2A2724, one mustard accent #EFA91B and one deep green accent #2E6B4F; neutral bright studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with every in-image word carried as a placeholder rather than source copy; thin single-weight line icons in the two accents only; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 product attitude and consistent sheet scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no source brand marks or identifiable faces
style.presentationRules: keep the crimped wall silhouette readable in every frame, consistent sheet scale between stack and basket screens, people reduced to adult hands or bodies cropped below the shoulders, never hide the sheet behind food
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone boards #E8E4DC over light oak counters #EDE7DE, with the natural paper body #C79355 as the recurring material note
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline plus short label weights, every in-image word carried as a placeholder never as source copy
